features.name: One modular AUG-CSL family, supplied in a large component briefcase; basic weapon is assault rifle and components support AR/SMG/rifle/LMG configurations.
ALL configurations retain integral top laser, barrel-mounted gas-vent1 system and RIGID stock. They share assault-rifle ammunition but use different feed clips/configurations.
Own AUGCSL family picture printed27/PDF29 supplies the broad body, rear stock opening, forward grip/support and upper laser unit; it does not individually label all four configurations.
